name: sevdesk-mcp
description: sevDesk accounting for Claude: vouchers, invoices, bank reconciliation and a built-in VAT audit layer.
long_description: The complete MCP server for sevDesk: every API endpoint via a searchable catalogue, guarded write tools (drafts by default, dry-run everywhere), and audits that know what a wrong booking looks like — reverse-charge mis-bookings, account/tax-rule mismatches, duplicates, missing receipts.

api_token.title: sevDesk API token
api_token.description: Found in sevDesk under Settings → Users → your user → API. The token has no scopes — treat it like a password.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Keep on until you deliberately want Claude to write to your books.
